acceptance_predicates.description: The paired qualification runner creates plans through the repository-owned plan create path with selected configuration and fresh content identity.
A fresh plan passes validation, local/mock execution, selected recording, strict offline replay, and comparison.
Stale or mismatched experiment, executable, or workload identity fails closed with typed diagnostics.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block the prototype.

definition_of_done: Exact paired ASB/TUI heads and plan, experiment, run, cassette, replay, and comparison evidence are recorded.
Independent review, hosted checks, generated projections, and no-secret scan pass.

inputs.description: Selected agent, provider/model, workload, executable, and replay configuration.

outputs.description: Privacy-safe exact-head plan, run, capture, replay, and comparison evidence.

gates.description: Experiment identity is freshly content-addressed and validated before execution.
Recording, strict offline replay, and comparison complete without provider contact.
